system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: copies the agent skills to the expected directory and installs an appropriate entry file, such asAGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, or engine-specific rules.
system_prompt_style.note: Reversa is a skill pack on top of a host engine; the system prompt is the host's, composed with the entry file and loaded skills.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Maps the surface: folder structure, languages, frameworks, dependencies, entry points
env_context_strategy.note: Scout agent explores the repo via host tools; the surface is saved to .reversa/context/surface.json.

context_compaction.note: Compaction belongs to the host engine; skill files were not in the bundle.

observation_format.note: Observation format is determined by the host engine.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is delegated to the host engine (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).

tool_count.note: Reversa defines no tools; the host engine supplies them.

edit_primitive.note: Edit primitives belong to the host engine.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool schemas come from the host engine.

protocol_standardization.note: No source files were opened for a grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Discovery pipeline (`/reversa`) is the heart of the framework: a 5-phase sequence orchestrated by the **Reversa** agent.
loop_primitives.note: Each phase runs inside the host's react loop. Bug Debate is an opt-in fixed-epoch debate.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a central orchestrator coordinates specialized agents to map the project surface, analyze modules, extract implicit rules, synthesize architecture, write unit-level specifications, and review generated claims.
multi_agent_topology.note: The paper does not state whether roles run as separate sub-agents; they may be sequential skills in one session, which would be closer to pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each orchestrator pauses between agents and asks for `CONTINUAR` before advancing, so you stay in control of every step.
delegation_mechanism.note: Inferred: skills hand off control sequentially within the host session.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Each orchestrator pauses between agents and asks for `CONTINUAR` before advancing, so you stay in control of every step.
human_in_loop.note: The default gates each stage. /reversa-autonomous removes intermediate stops. Bug Fix has approval gates before changes.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Progress is saved in `.reversa/state.json` at each checkpoint

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Manages durable project rules (`principles.md`) and emits impact reports when they change
long_term_memory.note: Artifacts in _reversa_sdd/ and _reversa_bugs/ persist across sessions; the skills are installed in .agents/skills/.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: if the session is interrupted, just type `reversa` to resume where you left off.
state_persistence.note: Resume is implemented through instructions (agents/reversa/references/step-02-resume.md) rather than code.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The Reviewer rereads the specifications, returns to the original code to check fragile claims, reclassifies items when necessary
self_verification.note: The Reviewer is a prompted role on the same host model. Spec SDD has a scorer script.

rollback.note: The README recommends a manual `git restore .`. Code Quality gates are described as 'reversible diff gate' without a stated mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Reversa takes the wheel and guides you to the end.
termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends when its phases complete; host-level caps are not part of Reversa.

cost_controls.note: The Reconstructor claims it is 'preserving tokens' but no mechanism is described.

execution_isolation.note: Execution happens in the host engine's environment.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: all writes are restricted to `.reversa/` and `_reversa_sdd/`
filesystem_access.note: Enforced by prompt directive only, not by a mechanism. Forward/Coding agents do write project code.

permission_model.evidence_quote: no destructive or outward-facing command (delete, `git push`, publish, install) is ever run on its own.
permission_model.note: This is a prompt-level blocklist in autonomous mode. Actual per-call permission is handled by the host engine.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: In the ATM case, expert precision and utility in downstream tasks were proposed as protocol metrics, but have not yet been measured in a controlled way.
eval_hooks.note: The file tree shows no evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: no destructive or outward-facing command (delete, `git push`, publish, install) is ever run on its own.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Turn legacy systems into executable specifications for AI agents.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: All intelligence is delegated to the AI agent already present in your environment (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.)
model_agnostic.note: Model-agnostic through engine portability across 13 host engines.

primary_artifact.note: The paper appeared 2026-05-18; the pinned repo postdates it.

first_release_date.note: The evidence gives neither a first-tag date nor a first-commit date.
